# ankra_cluster_stack_variable (Resource)

One variable of a stack on a cluster, referenced from the stack's manifests and add-on values as `${{ ankra.<name> }}`. It shadows a cluster or organisation variable of the same name. Each write changes only this key of the deployed stack and leaves the stack's other keys, and any pending draft, as they are; a changed value redeploys the stack members that reference it.

**Manage each key in one place only.** `ankra_cluster` does not send stack variables, so its applies keep the keys this resource sets. Anything that writes a stack's whole variable map replaces them, though: an `ankra cluster apply` whose stack carries a `variables` map, or publishing a stack draft (from the portal, say) that edits the stack's variables or other stack-level fields, because the draft does not pick up writes made after it was opened. After such a write the next plan shows the key missing or changed and sets it again.

Creating the resource for a key the stack already holds with the configured value adopts it; with another value it fails, so import the key instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Sets one key of the "platform" stack's variables; the stack's other keys
# are left as they are. The stack itself stays owned by ankra_cluster or the
# GitOps repository.
resource "ankra_cluster_stack_variable" "ingress_domain" {
  cluster_id = ankra_cluster.production.id
  stack_name = "platform"
  name       = "ingress_domain"
  value      = "apps.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `name` (String) Variable name: ASCII letters, digits and underscores. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `stack_name` (String) Name of the stack. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value. Stack variables have no secret mode: the platform stores the value in plain text and commits it to the cluster's GitOps repository, so keep secrets in a secret organisation variable instead. Marked sensitive so plans do not print it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<cluster_id>/<stack_name>/<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Stack variables are imported by <cluster_id>/<stack_name>/<name>.
terraform import ankra_cluster_stack_variable.ingress_domain 6f1c2a40-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/platform/ingress_domain
```
